video_title: Kelly Oubre Jr., Tyrese Haliburton and Braden Smith Media Availability | October 4, 2026

quotes.speaker: Kelly Oubre Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Kelly Oubre Jr. on the importance of team scrimmages
quotes.excerpt: just playing on the game floor, that's the first step, right? You get your juices going
quotes.quote: It felt great. Just playing on the game floor, that's the first step, right? You get your juices going, you can use your imagination a little bit. To wear the jerseys, I think it just elevated the one quarter that we did scrimmage. We've been playing against each other all week, and playing against our own teammates is a whole different story.
quotes.social_post: Kelly Oubre Jr. says getting on the game floor for scrimmages was a big step for the team. He noted that wearing the jerseys during the session elevated the intensity of their practice.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on his physical health after fan jam
quotes.excerpt: this is the first time I've left fan jam and felt my body's felt good
quotes.quote: Still defeated. I've never won a fan jam game, but this is the first time I've left fan jam and felt my body's felt good, so I'll take it. It was a good day.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton says he is feeling good physically after Fan Jam. He joked that while he has never won a Fan Jam game, this is the first time he has left the event feeling healthy.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the versatility of the second unit
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we have good size in our second group, they can guard multiple positions
quotes.quote: I feel like we have good size in our second group, they can guard multiple positions. They cause a different threat on the other side because they're so big, and I like that group a lot. They've had some really good days at camp, but when we play five-on-five full court, ask them how that goes.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton likes the versatility of the Pacers second unit. He noted the group has good size and can guard multiple positions, creating a different type of threat for opponents.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the immediate impact of Zuse
quotes.excerpt: such a big guy, poses a lot of different threats offensively and defensively
quotes.quote: Obviously, Zuse is such a big guy, poses a lot of different threats offensively and defensively, rebounding the basketball, outlets, all those things. We're just starting our connection, but I'm really enjoying playing alongside him for the first week or whatever, and I'm looking forward to playing against other teams here soon.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton is enjoying his early chemistry with Zuse. He says the big man poses a lot of threats offensively and defensively, specifically highlighting his rebounding and outlet passing.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the rookie song selection process
quotes.excerpt: ever since I've become the MC over the last two years, I like to run a democracy
quotes.quote: Ever since I've become the MC over the last two years, I like to run a democracy. I like to allow the rookies to pick their song, just with my approval. Kelly Oubre Jr. called me yesterday and said, 'I know no lyrics to any song.' And so I said, 'You got to pick one.' And he came back at party in the USA, so I would have thought he would have spent all night training. He didn't know a single word, really. Braden Smith wanted to do Tequila, I couldn't allow that, it's one word. Zuse was good, Zuse had a good song right away.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton shared some insight into the rookie song selection process. He says he runs a democracy as the MC, but he had to veto Braden Smith for trying to pick Tequila because it only has one word.

quotes.speaker: Braden Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Braden Smith on the team's practice performance
quotes.excerpt: we actually played in practice yesterday for the locker rooms, for the home locker room
quotes.quote: We actually played in practice yesterday for the locker rooms, for the home locker room and the visiting one, and we got beat 6 to 26.
quotes.social_post: Braden Smith admits the team took a tough loss in practice yesterday, falling 6 to 26 in a scrimmage session.

quotes.speaker: Braden Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Braden Smith on embracing the rookie hazing
quotes.excerpt: you got to like just buy into it. I know I'm not a good singer anyways
quotes.quote: You got to like just buy into it. I know I'm not a good singer anyways, and I was just like, 'You know what? It's going to be me getting made fun of either way, so might as well just enjoy it and have fun with it.'
quotes.social_post: Braden Smith says he is embracing the rookie hazing process. He knows he is not a good singer, so he decided he might as well just enjoy the experience.

quotes.speaker: Braden Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Braden Smith on the blue unit's performance
quotes.excerpt: if we limit them to a couple more rebounds, second chance points, it could be a lot different
quotes.quote: I thought obviously if we limit them to a couple more rebounds, second chance points to the kick-out threes, to the put-backs, I think it could be a lot different. We won by a lot more, but overall I thought we passed the ball, played together, and we made shots, which is what we didn't do yesterday.
quotes.social_post: Braden Smith says the blue unit played much better today. He noted that if they can limit second chance points and kick-out threes, they will be in a much better position to win.
